details: During pip install, the setup.py build command makes the bundled binary auclean/_auclean_native executable and runs it with --init. The binary looks for curl, wget, nc, ssh, docker and kubectl, runs ip addr and ip route, writes _ac files into /tmp, /output and /data and opens HTTPS connections, and auclean/_bootstrap.py downloads files from an anonymous workers.dev address. I did not see what the binary sends. Version 0.4.2 only.
